title: My data: a Daisy weather station file read and checked
intro: Here the Foulum station file of the bundled data was chosen as a file of your own. The line under the choice reports the years, the mean rain and temperature, the columns that were used and the notes of the checks.

marks.d: Name, first and last year, complete years, mean annual rain, mean temperature and the columns used.
The latitude, longitude and elevation read from the header of the file.
